/ middleware / RSC / streaming / Suspense) / Nuxt 3 Server Routes + route middleware / SvelteKit load + actions + hooks / Remix v2 + React Router v7 loader + action + Resource Routes + nested route chain / Astro Server Endpoints + SSR + View Transitions / ORM query (Drizzle / Prisma / Kysely × SQLite / Postgres / MySQL、 11 組合せ matrix) / Python pytest / Rust cargo test (unit + hyper mock_server queue / cache) に 6 provider (Clerk / Auth0 / Cloudflare Queues / SQS / Memcached / KeyDB) 追加 (親 Issue #651、 sub #652-#657)。
